caption:
The video captures a nighttime urban street blanketed in piled snow. The camera is already shifting steadily rightward, so fixed objects drift leftward across the frame. On the left a brightly lit storefront glows with purple, blue and white neon, where dark silhouettes of pedestrians gather near the entrance and one figure walks leftward past the snowbank. A small bare tree, two yellow marker posts and a glowing blue diamond-shaped light sit in the middle ground.

A bare tree trunk stands in the right foreground. As the view shifts, this trunk travels leftward toward the frame edge, its motion more pronounced than the background's. The yellow posts likewise slide out of view. On the right a darker building with rows of windows, two cylindrical illuminated advertising displays, a warm street lamp and a parked dark car move toward the center, some entering from the edge. A red sign structure also appears near the right.

The lateral movement remains in progress throughout, with the neon-lit area now fully out of frame.
relations: Rightward camera pan causes the left neon storefront and gathered silhouettes to drift left and exit the frame.
The foreground tree trunk shifts left more rapidly than background structures, producing pronounced parallax during the pan.
Continued rightward motion carries the yellow posts and blue light out of view toward the left edge.
As the view shifts, the right-side building, displays and parked car slide toward the frame center.
